info.name: SSG TPG Gateway
info.description:
Every route of the SSG TPG Gateway (this project). Requests go to the gateway, which handles the SSG certificate, `x-api-version` headers and payload encryption.

Setup:
1. Start the gateway: `npm start`
2. Set the collection variables `baseUrl` and `apiKey` (the GATEWAY_API_KEY from .env).
3. Fill in the ID variables (runId, enrolmentReferenceNumber, ...) as you get them from SSG responses.

Requests marked ⚠ change live data on SSG when the gateway points to production. Sample bodies use placeholder values.

Tests:
- Every request has tests. Run the whole collection with the Postman Runner or `postman collection run`.
- Requests marked ⚠ are skipped unless the variable `allowWrites` is "true". Only enable it against the SSG sandbox, or when you mean to change live data.
- Create requests save new IDs (runId, sessionId, trainerId, enrolmentReferenceNumber, assessmentReferenceNumber) for the requests after them.
